item.text: I’ll update the GNOME favorites setting directly so Vim no longer appears in the dock favorites.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc "gsettings get org.gnome.shell favorite-apps && ls /usr/share/applications | rg -i 'vim|gvim|nvim' || true"
/bin/bash -lc "gsettings get org.gnome.shell favorite-apps && ls /usr/share/applications | rg -i 'vim|gvim|nvim' || true"

item.text: The dock favorites currently include `vim.desktop`, so I’m removing just that entry and leaving the other favorites intact.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc "gsettings set org.gnome.shell favorite-apps \"['thunderbird.desktop', 'google-chrome.desktop']\" && gsettings get org.gnome.shell favorite-apps"
/bin/bash -lc "gsettings set org.gnome.shell favorite-apps \"['thunderbird.desktop', 'google-chrome.desktop']\" && gsettings get org.gnome.shell favorite-apps"
